title: M5Stack NanoC6 · C125
summary: 集成 ESP32-C6、RGB LED、红外发射、按键和 Grove 接口的微型开发板，支持 Wi-Fi 6、Thread 与 Zigbee。
assemblyNotes: Select source components 0 and 2 in assembled positions; rotate +90 degrees around Z to Grove-up portrait orientation, preserving millimetres.

derivedParts.notes: Open roof and visible pin channel follow official front/oblique photos; redundant solid housing removed. Dimensions/hidden depth estimated; physical pin orientation and insertion fit not verified, therefore connections remain disabled. USB-C visual mouth position estimated from side photo, ±1 mm; no exact-fit claim.

G7 blue light behind central rear USB-end slot, per official annotated photo. Hidden depth and optical area are estimated, not PCB CAD.

facts.label: 重量来源差异
facts.value: 规格表与称重照片为 2.7 g；同页宣传图写 2.5 g，未确定版本差异。

limitations: Manufacturer CAD contains enclosure only; visible Grove/USB inserts are photo-derived approximations; label details are absent.
Exterior shell dimensions pass 0.1 mm tolerance; this does not certify absent connectors or populated board.
No display exists on NanoC6; no fabricated screen or framebuffer is added.
Partial runtime supports the G9 key, G19-powered G20 RGB and G7 blue LED; IR, RF and external Grove/factory display behavior are unverified.
PCB placeholder has no components. Its dimensions/placement are an enclosure-space estimate, not a verified PCB layout.
Manufacturer photo rights are separate from CAD MIT license. Materials are visual approximations, not measured reflectance.
photoReview: 实际浏览器四视图确认 Grove 朝上方向，依据官方照片改为青色壳体；壳体尺寸检查通过。官方 CAD 未包含照片中白色 Grove 端子、USB 金属内芯和文字；当前 UNKNOWN PCB 通过开口可见，外观仍不完整，未标记 1:1 通过。
